SELECT COALESCE(j.trigger_kind::text, 'none') AS "trigger!",
                  (CASE WHEN c.status = 'failure' THEN COALESCE(
                     (SELECT rc.status FROM v2_job r
                        JOIN native_retry_attempt n ON n.job_id = r.id
                        JOIN v2_job_completed rc ON rc.id = r.id
                       WHERE r.parent_job = j.id
                       ORDER BY n.attempt DESC LIMIT 1),
                     c.status) ELSE c.status END)::text AS "status!",
                  COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count!"
             FROM (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, path FROM script
                    WHERE auto_kind = 'pipeline' AND archived = false AND deleted = false
                      AND workspace_id NOT LIKE 'wm-fork%') p
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
               SELECT id, trigger_kind FROM v2_job
                WHERE workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND runnable_path = p.path
                  AND parent_job IS NULL AND kind = 'script'
                  AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
                  AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE
             ) j
             JOIN v2_job_completed c ON c.id = j.id
            GROUP BY 1, 2
